transcript: Here's how you can meal prep 10 high protein chicken burrito bowls for less than $20. That's perfect for weight loss. I'll show you how to make it. With your crock pot on high, add 3 pounds of chicken breast, 1 packet of taco seasoning, and let this cook on high for 4 hours or low for 6. After 4 hours, shred and drain your chicken breast. Next add 1 can of rinsed black beans, 2 10 ounce cans of diced tomatoes and green chilies, 1 cup of shredded cheese, 1 diced white onion, 2 bell peppers, and 2 packs of ready rice. You can also use one cup of dry rice and cook that down. Give this a good mix and let it cook on low for 30 more minutes. Personally for an additional topping I like to add salsa. Most salsas are only an extra 10 calories for 2 tablespoons. Light sour cream is only an additional 35 calories for 2 tablespoons. And some fresh cilantro on top. You can typically get a bundle of cilantro for only $1. One serving size is only 445 calories with 48 grams of protein and 33 grams of carbs.
